correctness.rationale: Exact star generator from inspected RESULT.md has leaf rates (n-k)(a+hz), k(a+h(1-z)), hub rates a+hk/n and a+h(1-k/n). Scaling by lambda=2a+h produces the two deterministic velocities -y,1-y and state-dependent switching rates alpha+beta*y, alpha+beta*(1-y), where 2alpha+beta=1; zero-flux transport equations give density proportional y^(alpha-1)(1-y)^(alpha-1) and P(H=1|y)=y. Pair-spin generator closes A_n,C_n and yields the stated rational variance with h²/[4(8a(a+h)+h²)] positive limit. Direct independent algebra matches all finite formulas and the earlier theorem; no extrapolation of finite cases is used.
